description: Generate tests/relabel_cases.json: reference cases for the Kotlin port of refpipe/relabel.py.  Each case: params, words [[start_ms, end_ms]], turns [[speaker, start_ms, end_ms]] | null, embeddings (RAW per-unit extractor outputs, 6 decimals; the port must L2-normalise them: e / (|e| + 1e-9)), and the expected result: units [[start, end, w0, w1]], labels per unit, turns [[label, start, end]], diag (silhouette per k, best_k, k1). Cases without "embeddings" only check the unit segmentation.   python tools/make_relabel_cases.py

cases.name: units_gap
cases.description: pauses <= gap_ms keep words in one unit, a longer pause starts a new one

cases.name: units_max_unit
cases.description: a unit never spans more than max_unit_ms

cases.name: units_split_by_turns
cases.description: cut between words with different dominant turns if both sides >= split_min_side_ms

cases.name: units_split_side_too_short
cases.description: no cut when one side would be shorter than split_min_side_ms

cases.name: units_dominant_tie_first_turn
cases.description: equal overlap: the first turn in the list wins; a word without any turn has no dominant

cases.name: three_speakers
cases.description: three speakers in random order (k=3 has the best silhouette)

cases.name: monologue_no_guard
cases.description: one speaker, noisy embeddings, guard off -> the search still returns k>=2 (best silhouette is low, ~0.33)

cases.name: monologue_guard
cases.description: same data, k1_silhouette_thr=0.5 -> the best silhouette is below it -> everyone is label 0

cases.name: dialogue_guard_passes
cases.description: two speakers: the silhouette is above the guard threshold -> k=2

cases.name: short_units_labelled_by_centroid
cases.description: units < min_reliable_ms are excluded from clustering and get the nearest centroid

cases.name: max_cluster_units
cases.description: more reliable units than max_cluster_units: only the longest ones are clustered

cases.name: refine_0
cases.description: same embeddings, refine=0: 0 extra rounds of centroid re-estimation from all units

cases.name: refine_1
cases.description: same embeddings, refine=1: 1 extra rounds of centroid re-estimation from all units

cases.name: refine_3
cases.description: same embeddings, refine=3: 3 extra rounds of centroid re-estimation from all units

cases.name: k_max_limits_search
cases.description: k_max=2 stops the search at 2 clusters although 4 speakers are present

cases.name: split_then_cluster
cases.description: a run of words is cut at the turn change into two units; 3 units in total (k_min=2)
